name: Banh bot loc
summary: The city tourism portal uses two names. The 18 May 2020 page puts bánh lọc with bánh bèo, bánh nậm, and bánh xèo. The Con Market pages put bánh bột lọc on the outdoor counters. They do not say whether that is one cake, and they do not describe the filling.
origin: Named in Da Nang with the small steamed cakes. A filling was not given.
howToEat: The city pages name the cake and do not describe a method. Check on arrival.

In Dong Hoi the cake is hot cassava flour, filled with shrimp and pork, plain or in a banana leaf, and also fried. One account adds mushroom and sour bamboo shoot. Another adds wood-ear and mung bean.
where: Bánh lọc is grouped with the cakes an ordinary Da Nang restaurant will have, on the 18 May 2020 page. Bánh bột lọc is on the outdoor counters at Con Market, on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup and the 4 Oct 2024 market page.
In Dong Hoi the cake is on Lê Thành Đồng and Đồng Hải. Chợ Đồng Hới also splits a hot loaf and fills it with shrimp cakes and mung-bean cakes, plus a hot sauce.
seoTitle: Banh bot loc — the Da Nang cake name
seoDescription: Da Nang’s city pages say bánh lọc beside bánh bèo and bánh nậm, and bánh bột lọc at Con Market. They do not describe the filling. Check on arrival.
